Followup from last ACDE: 

- It seems there is consensus on using the CL block retention window for history expiry. I'd be keen to either update 4444 or have some informational EIP so that this is documented

- [Nethermind PR](https://github.com/NethermindEth/nethermind/pull/12808) to change it is here. Is there an update from other clients?

- Could clients and other entities also update [history endpoints](https://eth-clients.github.io/history-endpoints/) so we have a list of folks who are providing history? [Nethermind and PandaOps added here](https://github.com/eth-clients/history-endpoints/pull/17)
